import-after-ashes: A young adult East Asian woman traveler holds a tiny packet of green seeds at an abandoned railway station at dawn. Rusted tracks lead from a dry ruined city toward a lush distant green valley. A teenage girl and an adult mechanic wait beside an old radio. Hopeful post-apocalyptic adventure, warm green glow against charcoal ash, no fire spectacle.
import-salt-archive: An adult woman Lena holds a sealed red envelope beside a coastal archive building at night. A faded photograph of an older woman peeks from the envelope without readable markings. Calm silver sea, rising mist, flood-warning tower, mysterious reflected lights. Sophisticated coastal mystery, indigo, silver and one vivid crimson accent.
import-reverse-clock-inn: An adult East Asian woman Yuna shelters a small wounded fox cub outside a mysterious old inn under an enormous antique clock. Dark narrow city streets, distant silhouetted guards, a window glowing amber. Surreal time mystery, teal night and antique gold, compassionate heroine, no visible wounds or gore.
ss-r4-l1-a: Two adult women at a charming small-town post office in morning sunlight: a 24-year-old new mail carrier Ada with a canvas mailbag, and a 29-year-old visitor Mara holding one red envelope. A retiring older postman stands inside. Winding lanes and mailboxes beyond the door. Warm literary adventure, violet shadows, honey gold and soft coral, emotional human warmth.
ss-r4-l1-b: Anthropomorphic otter woman Nia, a friendly beaver and a rabbit stand beside an aging wooden bridge over a flowing river. A vivid red safety rope stretches across the bridge entrance. Beautiful illustrated fantasy with plush expressive characters, warm green foliage and red rope, hopeful teamwork, no childish clip art.
ss-r4-l2-a: A 20-year-old East Asian woman map keeper Lin with a rolled map and an old manual stands on a stone balcony overlooking a misty mountain town and a disused railway station. A great bronze warning bell hangs overhead; a red lamp glows near an old waterwheel. Mountain-town mystery and discovery, blue-teal dawn, amber light, expansive sense of wonder.
ss-r4-l2-b: A 24-year-old East Asian woman night-shift baker Yun and a 27-year-old male coworker Ren at a small café at four in the morning. Two steaming coffee cups, flour-dusted hands, a suitcase tucked near the door. Rain runs down a luminous blue window, empty sleepy street outside. Quiet adult romance, intimate restrained chemistry, warm amber interior and deep cobalt night, no embrace required.
ss-r2-l3-a: An adult East Asian woman Mira in a dark coat follows a single red thread into an impossibly vast library after sunset. Towering bookshelves bend into shadow; a large antique clock has no hands; a small open letter is held close to her. Magical literary suspense, mysterious architecture and readable emotional face, inky blue, deep violet and warm gold shafts of light.
ss-r4-l3-b: An adult 26-year-old East Asian female playwright Mara stands on an empty theatre stage holding a script with a conspicuously blank page. An adult male lighting designer Theo watches from the lighting booth, respectful distant connection. Velvet red curtains, one blue pencil on a wooden seat, golden stage spotlight, moody creative mystery and slow-burn romance. No readable text on paper.
ss-r3-l4-a: A 29-year-old East Asian female cartographer Pei Zhiwei stands at the entrance of a grand civic opera house holding a paper street map and a copper lamp. Beyond her, a neon coastal city is crossed by luminous supernatural waves and a broken bridge. She looks observant and determined, ordinary work clothes, no combat armor. Urban fantasy strategy adventure, electrifying teal, copper and violet.
ss-r4-l4-b: A 31-year-old Taiwanese woman Lin Yingshu stands beside her mother's grocery stall in a 1997 coastal traditional market. A second hand-painted wooden sign leans beside sacks, scales and a landline telephone. Rain shines on the narrow lane; older vendors look toward changing buildings. Nostalgic literary drama, authentic 1990s Taiwan atmosphere, warm vermilion, jade green and worn golden light, no modern phone, no readable signage.
ss-r4-l5-a: An adult East Asian woman accountant Lin Yu stands in an urban community bus depot during a shimmering heat wave. Contemporary social mystery with dramatic cinematic shadows, sun-bleached gold and deep navy, compelling human stakes, no readable documents.
ss-r4-l5-b: Two adult East Asian men at a stormy mountain-sea frontier: a 31-year-old repairman Gu Yuan carrying worn tools and a 30-year-old coastal cartographer Ren Hai holding a glowing compass. ss-r2-l6-a: An adult East Asian noblewoman Seren in a deep violet dress stands defiantly in a high vaulted fantasy courtroom. An open archival file rests in her hands; broken light from tall windows falls across the floor; a distant archive glows with embers in the background, a subtle echo of a past fire. ss-r2-l6-b: A 34-year-old East Asian woman Iris Lin holds an old brass hotel key at the gate of a weathered coastal family hotel, the Lantern House.
